title: shadcn/ui
notes: One of the references that shaped Scout (PRD §6); the default component foundation for React app work. Copy-in, not a dependency — components land in the repo and get edited there, which is also why its polish standard is the bar for Scout's own browse page (D-006).
summary: A set of open-code React components you copy into your project and own — "customize, extend, and build on" — rather than install as a package dependency. Positioned as the foundation for a design system: standard app UI (dialogs, forms, tables, command menus) scaffolded via a CLI (`init` for new apps, `add <component>` for pieces), with the source living in your repo from then on.
surfaces_when: building a dialog, dropdown, form, data table, or command menu in a React app
starting a new React or Next.js app that needs a component foundation or design system
a plan calls for accessible UI primitives the project will customize and own rather than take as a locked dependency
ambient_line: shadcn/ui — copy-in React components; reach for it when building standard UI in a React app.
